digest.component_or_area: Codex Gerrit workflow documentation and testing
propositions: Codex sessions incorrectly treat curl --netrc 401 responses as proof that Gerrit HTTPS credentials are invalid when credentials are actually managed by Git credential helper

AGENTS.md must document that authenticated Gerrit /a/ REST polling requires git credential fill when Git credentials are stored in a configured credential helper, and that curl --netrc is only valid when .netrc was explicitly configured
The documented credential pattern must keep credentials in variables, pass them directly to curl, and never echo or log passwords while preserving existing git push and Gerrit gate guidance
test_codex_agent_guidance.py must include assertions validating git credential fill usage, curl --netrc applicability, the 401 false-positive explanation, and password non-logging requirements
